title: Shared definitions
description: Definitions the manifest schemas share: ids, part ids, palette roles, colours, cast members.

id.description: A library id: lowercase letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores.

partId.description: <category>/<name> for a library part, <avatar>/<name> for a part only that avatar wears.

role.description: A palette role such as skin.base or top.trim-tip.

roleName.description: A cast role such as host.

slot.description: A slot of a base, such as hair-front.

colour.description: A colour (#rgb, #rgba, #rrggbb, #rrggbbaa, rgb(), rgba(), black, white, transparent, none) or a token reference such as {color.accent}.

palette.description: Palette role -> colour or token reference.

file.description: A file name relative to the manifest.

castMember.description: A presenter of an episode: the avatar, its look, and palette and part option overrides.

options.description: Part id -> options passed to that part, over the look's.

voice.description: The voice preset of the avatar's voice.json; default: the script's voice, else the preset named default.
